Profile

Lossless listening

Engine32-bit float mixing
Running at–
Resampling–
  1. In Audio MIDI Setup (Applications → Utilities), select your DAC and set its format to the rate you work at, for example 96 kHz, 32-bit.
  2. Keep Sample rate: Automatic in Audio system, so the app runs at exactly the DAC's rate and nothing is resampled.
  3. Leave the computer's volume at 100% and set loudness on the DAC (or with the DAC slider on the master strip in the desktop app).
  4. Keep the master below 0 dB; the safety limiter catches accidents.

Autosave

Autosave–

Inside a .audiolab file

  • Every track, clip, note, section and automation line
  • All instruments and effects with their settings, plus the mixer
  • The audio files and samples you imported, so the project opens complete on any Mac

Where files are saved

Save opens the normal Mac save window, so you pick the folder and the name. Where the browser does not allow that window (for example when AudioLab runs inside the Claude app), you type a name and the file goes to your Downloads folder. In Chrome you can turn on “Ask where to save each file before downloading” to choose the folder every time. You can also drop a .audiolab file onto the arrangement to open it.
